tasks.title: Conversation #69
tasks.transcript:
Woman: How's your job at the campus bookstore going?
Man: Pretty good. It was really hectic last week, which is no surprise because the semester is just starting.
Woman: Right. I actually avoided all that by ordering my books online. It was a smart move.
Man: Things have calmed down, thankfully. I think this actually might be my last semester at the bookstore, though. I heard that the tutoring center is looking for biology tutors. That's my major. So.

questions.stem: What does the woman imply when she mentions ordering books online?

options.A: She did it to avoid crowds at a bookstore.
options.B: She was able to find cheaper books online.
options.C: She could not find all the books she needed online.
options.D: She waited for a week to receive her books.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：当女士提到在网上订书时，她暗示了什么？ 定位原文：Woman: Right. I actually avoided all that by ordering my books online. It was a smart move. 选项分析： A. 她这样做是为了避免书店里的人潮。男士提到上周书店非常忙碌（hectic），因为学期刚开始。女士回应说她通过网上订书“避免了所有那些（avoided all that）”，并称这是“明智之举”，这暗示她是为了避开书店的拥挤，因此 A 选项正确。 B. 她能在网上找到更便宜的书。女士完全没有提到价格比较，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 她在网上找不到所有需要的书。女士说网上订书帮她避免了拥挤，暗示她成功买到了书，而非找不到，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 她等了一周才收到书。女士没有提及配送时间，因此 D 选项错误。

questions.stem: What can be inferred about the man?

options.A: He has been receiving biology tutoring.
options.B: He will graduate at the end of the semester.
options.C: He will receive a promotion at the bookstore.
options.D: He might be changing jobs soon.

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：关于男士，可以推断出什么？ 定 位 原 文 ： Man: ... I think this actually might be my last semester at the bookstore,though. I heard that the tutoring center is looking for biology tutors. That's my major. So. 选项分析： A. 他一直在接受生物辅导。男士提到自己的专业是生物，并且辅导中心在招生物辅导老师，暗示他可能去当 tutor，而非接受辅导，因此 A 选项错误。 B. 他将在本学期末毕业。男士说这可能是他在书店的最后一个学期，但并未说明是因为毕业，也可能是换工作，因此 B 选项错误。 C. 他将在书店获得晋升。男士说这可能是他在书店的最后一个学期，暗示他可能要离开，而非晋升，因此 C 选项错误。 D. 他可能很快就要换工作了。男士明确说这可能是他在书店的最后一个学期，并且提到辅导中心在招生物辅导老师（他的专业），暗示他可能去应聘，从而换工作，因此 D 选项正确。
